description: Retrieve columns referenced by a dashboard, including widget and filter columns.

dashboard_name.description: Title of the dashboard to retrieve columns from.

examples.user_query: What columns are used in the Sales Performance dashboard?
examples.notes: This retrieves all columns referenced by the 'Sales Performance' dashboard, including those used in widgets and filters.

examples.user_query: Can you list the columns in the Marketing Overview dashboard?
examples.notes: This call identifies all columns associated with the 'Marketing Overview' dashboard, ensuring a complete view of its data dependencies.

examples.user_query: I need to find the columns used in the Executive Summary dashboard for auditing purposes.
examples.notes: Use this to extract and review all columns tied to the 'Executive Summary' dashboard, helping with data audits or dependency checks.
